Trace fixtures of one score (`fur-elise.yaml`, compiled to `fur-elise.sid`).

- `fur-elise.vice-dump.txt`: output of `vsid -console -warp -silent -limit 3000000 -sounddev dump -soundarg <file> fur-elise.sid` (VICE 3.10), the first 3,000,000 cycles.
- `fur-elise.siddump.txt`: output of siddump V1.11 (Cadaver, BSD-3, built from the unmodified sources) `siddump fur-elise.sid -t10`.
